title: Aug 13, 2026Frontier Red TeamPatterns and problems in emerging multiagent systems
content: Aug 13, 2026Frontier Red TeamPatterns and problems in emerging multiagent systems
summary_zh: Anthropic 前沿红队团队分析了新兴多智能体（multiagent）系统中出现的典型模式与问题，涉及 agent 之间的协作结构与失效风险。对于设计 Claude Code 子智能体编排、workflow 并行方案的开发者有参考价值，可帮助规避多 agent 架构中的常见陷阱。

title: The builder’s guide to GPT‑5.6
content: Learn how startups use GPT-5.6 to build faster, more cost-efficient AI agents with smarter model selection and new Responses API capabilities.
summary_zh: OpenAI 官方发布的 GPT-5.6 开发者指南，面向创业公司讲解如何构建更快、更具成本效益的 AI Agent。核心内容包括更智能的模型选择策略（按任务复杂度路由到合适的模型档位）以及 Responses API 的新能力。对做 LLM 工作流和 Agent 编排的开发者有直接参考价值。

title: v2.1.232
content: What's changed Subagent forking is now on by default: a subagent_type: "fork" subagent inherits the full conversation and prompt cache, and non-teammate agent spawns in interactive sessions now run in the background by default Type @ in the prompt to mention another Claude session by name; Claude then uses SendMessage to reach that session directly SendMessage now delivers to a bare name that exactly matches one live session, instead of asking to confirm with a ref first Interactive sessions on one machine now keep unique names: starting or renaming a session to a name another live session already uses gives it a name-word-word variant and tells you Added /config rows for "Dialog expiry" and "Messages from your other sessions" (cross-session inbound accept/hold/refuse) Added secret redaction for GitLab token families ( glrt- , gloas- , glptt- , glagent- , glimt- , glsoat- , glcbt- , glft- , glffct- ) and full redaction of routable glpat- / gldt- tokens; the glab CLI config store gets t
author: ashwin-ant
summary_zh: Claude Code v2.1.232 版本更新，默认开启子代理 fork 模式（继承完整对话与提示缓存），非队友代理在交互会话中默认后台运行。新增 @ 提及其他 Claude 会话并通过 SendMessage 直接通信、同机会话名称唯一化、以及「对话框过期」与「跨会话消息接收」的 /config 配置项和密钥脱敏功能。

title: Update claude-api skill: prompt-audit subcommand (#1557)
content:
Update claude-api skill: prompt-audit subcommand (#1557)

* Add prompt-audit subcommand to claude-api skill

New shared/prompt-audit.md: a non-interactive audit that inventories the
prompt surface, dates each instruction, scans against dated-pattern
tables, and produces a findings report plus a proposed diff. SKILL.md
gains the subcommand row, a cross-reference from migrate, carve-outs in
the provider check and language detection for the non-interactive
contract, and a reading-guide entry. model-migration.md points at the
audit from its prompt-behavior section.

No-Verification-Needed: markdown-only skill content, no runtime surface

* Replace prompt-audit exception callouts with an intent check in language detection

No-Verification-Needed: markdown-only skill content, no runtime surface
author: cj-ant
summary_zh: Anthropic 官方 skills 仓库为 claude-api skill 新增 prompt-audit 子命令：以非交互方式盘点提示词表面、为每条指令标注时间、对照「过时模式表」扫描，并输出发现报告与建议 diff。适合在模型迁移（model-migration）前后审计既有提示词，识别针对旧模型编写的过时写法。

title: Previewing Ultrafast mode: GPT-5.6 Sol at up to 14X the speed
content: Preview Ultrafast, a new OpenAI API service tier that runs GPT-5.6 Sol up to 14× faster. Powered by Cerebras, it delivers up to 750 output tokens per second.
summary_zh: OpenAI 推出 Ultrafast API 服务层预览，由 Cerebras 芯片驱动运行 GPT-5.6 Sol，推理速度提升最高达 14 倍，输出可达每秒 750 tokens。对需要低延迟的 AI 编程工具、实时代码补全和 Agent 工作流具有直接影响，超高吞吐可显著改善交互式编码体验。

title: What We Learned by Reproducing 2,200 papers from ICML
summary_zh: 文章分享了大规模复现 ICML 2,200 篇论文的经验，聚焦研究可复现性中的常见障碍（环境依赖、代码缺失、结果偏差）与工程化复现流程。对构建自动化论文复现/代码执行工作流有参考价值，但与 Claude Code 本身关联较弱。注：本次提供的正文为无关的插件配置文本，摘要主要基于标题推断，建议补全原文后再评估。
